source.scope: Original continuous ordinary main-loop branch 0x4a63d2..0x4aaded (or crashed-contact entry 0x4ab426): complete contacts, component/cooldown, initial shared forces, roll target, subsequent mount world-position reads, wheel levers, front contact axis and chassis terrain probes, crash component steering and airborne/landing flags, takeoff state capture and rider weight filtering and grounded/airborne force reference position, local/crash reference transform and front suspension response, steering velocity and front load preparation and front tangent/contact velocity and front tire force, rear-only entry and rotating rear suspension and rear drive force, rear contact load/velocity, traction scaling and rear tire force and combined force/torque accumulation, front/rear braking and no-wheel suspension cleanup, merged chassis contact geometry, velocity and penetration correction, contact-count-dependent angular response and crash damping, real single-body impulse wrapper and solver, post-impulse speed and low-speed stopping, low-speed lean angular gate, front/rear suspension force assembly and airborne arm/history cleanup, single- and both-contact force/torque assembly, sequential pitch clips/counter and drive torque with preserved skipped scratch/control state. Finite synthetic state and terrain, four-node parent/child graphs with all mount pairings and aliasing, speed/angle boundaries and signed-zero cases. Pinned Wine 11 D3DRM. Initial query scratch and exit observation boundaries supplied. Includes inertia-scaled angular acceleration and contact-mask/pivot rotation correction. Later integration and whole-bike trajectories excluded.
